requested_outcome: Unify and lock the VII application, Edge worker and cache release path, publish one aligned production version, and verify fast non-blank behavior across the affected public route families.
authorization_boundary: Local code, tests, release safeguards, production deployment and public verification are authorized by Adir's current request; unrelated product redesigns, purchases and outbound messages are excluded.

lesson_bundle.reason: The observed failures recur when application, Edge and cache release identities drift.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require one recorded release identity, exact public headers, rollback evidence and stale-source overwrite protection.

lesson_bundle.reason: A single repaired deep link is not proof of the complete affected delivery family.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require natural-destination checks for representative worlds, loading states, mobile, desktop and failure recovery.

lesson_bundle.reason: Slow navigation must acknowledge input and must never expose a blank page.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Verify immediate loading feedback, bounded wait, success replacement and actionable failure behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: The reported blank and delayed routes are especially damaging on mobile.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Treat 390-pixel mobile navigation, reload and route transitions as primary release checks.

lesson_bundle.reason: The release and cache mechanism is shared by every public world.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Expand verification from spa to vacation, events, hourly, providers and shared content routes.

lesson_bundle.reason: Builds and browser tests must not leave owned processes consuming the workstation.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Create an owned-process manifest and pass cleanup verification before completion.

lesson_bundle.reason: The prior question-mark escalation signals repeated unverified completion and requires direct corrective action.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Do not return reassurance; require deployed identity and visible public evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: VII has project-specific multi-world search, cache and release requirements.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Preserve booking authority, world-specific behavior and the approved master-plan boundaries.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The app is published but the Edge worker still expects a different build and bypasses or rejects cache.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add a deterministic release gate that reads the deployed build and blocks worker publication on mismatch.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact public app build equals the worker expected build in source, deployment metadata and live diagnostics.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The repaired spa deep link works but another world still shows a blank page or slow uncached navigation.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inventory the shared document-delivery family and test representative cold and warm routes in every public world.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Representative vacation, spa, events, hourly, provider and content routes render meaningful mobile and desktop content without blank states.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A fast cache path accidentally stores booking, account, session or Flight state under a shared key.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep transactional/private state excluded and retain full router identity for Flight responses.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Automated negative tests reject booking, account, cookie-private and unsafe query variants while Flight variants remain isolated.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Internal tests pass but the version actually online is different or is overwritten by another source.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Freeze exact source, app, worker and route identities and verify the natural destination after the final deployment.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Public headers, deployed worker version, source commit and visible browser result agree after reload and a prior-version-tab continuity check.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The release appears fast when warm but cold requests still overload origin or expose an error page.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Measure cold and warm document requests and verify bounded degraded behavior and origin fallback.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Cold and warm samples meet the recorded latency gate and never display provider or framework error pages.

affected_family: Application publication and deployed build identity
R2 public document cache keys and invalidation
HTML documents and Next.js Flight responses
Vacation, spa, events, hourly, provider and content public routes
Booking, account, session, preview and private query exclusions
Desktop, 390-pixel mobile, cold, warm, reload, back and stale-tab states

sources.label: VII platform architecture and release decisions
VII accepted loading and navigation behavior
Observed spa package blank-page incident and scoped repair

midpoint_gate.trigger: After reproducing the current build-alignment state and validating the release gate locally, before any production deployment.
checks: The gate fails on an intentionally mismatched build identity
The gate passes on the exact current production identity
Private and transactional cache exclusions remain intact

attack_questions: Can a new app build be published while the worker still expects the prior build?
Can an unsafe booking, account, session or Flight variant enter the shared HTML cache?
Does any representative public world show a blank, framework error or contradictory stale state on cold mobile navigation?
Does a pre-release browser tab continue working after the final deployment?
Can the exact prior worker and application version be restored?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public URLs, live headers, timing results and visually inspected desktop/mobile browser states on the deployed candidate.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated cache-safety suites plus representative public routes for every shared world and state family.

effectiveness.baseline: The spa package deep link timed out beyond 30 seconds before the scoped repair, and repeated releases required manual build/worker reconciliation.
effectiveness.target: One deterministic release gate, one aligned public deployment, no blank representative routes, and warm document delivery below one second where cacheable.
